reason: Metadata parser read only alphanumeric underscore in a hyphenated linked runbook ID. Every graph lookup was truncated, yielding invalid observed evidence completeness.
remediation: Parser accepts hyphenated IDs; added required linked_pair positive test; recalibrated on dev and switched to untouched 20261211..20261215 holdout seeds.

raw_untrusted_pre_fix_output.experiment: DRAG-inspired abstention and two-hop evidence: calibrated offline A/B
raw_untrusted_pre_fix_output.method: Real pinned prior BM25 class; synthetic schema guard; actual in-memory pointer following; no original DRAG_QPP/SFT
raw_untrusted_pre_fix_output.corpus: 12 disjoint calibration and 12 disjoint holdout DBA topics; 96 docs and 84 queries per seed, 7 classes

negative_controls: observation whose link points to another case's runbook
wrong runbook deliberately selected as negative control
gold mutation must change evaluation without changing retrieval
limitations: No human-blinded real-document relevance labels; the generator and oracle share a synthetic schema.
Exact event identifiers and observation/runbook links are artificial and deliberately machine-readable.
Holdout uses disjoint topics and changed document order but retains the schema; zero transfer-to-production claims.
Calibration optimization is performed only on dev; hardcoded feature design may be biased to this fixture family.
The graph follow is an O(1) in-memory lookup, not a real second retrieval over production index.
Same-process memory highwater and cached IO are not per-arm memory/disk costs.
No LLM, real RAG generator, author DRAG_QPP/SFT, real invoices, tokens or VRAM use.
Potentially unsafe abstention on unknown real questions: owner gate and independent real-query oracle needed.
